PROFILE.NAME: Endre Pakai
PROFILE.TITLE: Full Stack Developer
PROFILE.DESCRIPTION:
I am an enthusiastic software engineer with over 10 years of experience, having participated in the full lifecycle of application development, successfully launching various products. I am always eager to expand my knowledge, particularly in emerging technologies such as AI, while continuously refining my existing skills.

I was born on January 7, 1986, in Zrenjanin, and at the age of 10, I moved to Subotica, where I successfully completed my studies. Since childhood, I have had two main passions: drawing and computers/electronics—essentially, anything I could tinker with. Programming became a natural extension of this passion, as it allows me to create something from nothing, much like an advanced form of "tinkering."

Originally, I pursued graphic design in high school, but my interest in technology led me to shift my focus to IT, specifically programming. I thrive on learning new things, keeping up with technological advancements, and continuously improving my skills.

Although my first impression might come across as reserved or introverted, I consider myself a friendly and open-minded person. Over the years, I have gained extensive experience in software design and development, allowing me to approach projects with a structured and innovative mindset.

DIY.TITLE: DIY Project
DIY.DESCRIPTION:
I built this DIY Arduino Mega-based prototype with the goal of later integrating it into a synthesizer. This way, it will not only look more aesthetically pleasing but will also be more appealing and easier to use for children.

I created this device to teach my kids about music in a fun way—without having to learn how to play myself. The prototype works simply: first, an SD card is inserted, which has previously been loaded with MIDI files. The device reads these files and plays the melody.

Additionally, I included a learning mode: during playback, the corresponding keys light up, allowing children to easily follow the rhythm and learn the basics of playing music.
